t: The Waste Injector allows you to insert waste material from the Reactor into the Reprocessor.$(br2)The graphical interface can be used to insert materials manually, or you can connect a pipe of some sort to insert waste into the injector.
废料注入器允许你将反应堆中的废料插入再处理器。$(br2)你可以通过图形界面手动插入材料，也可以连接某种管道，将废料自动输入到注入器中。
$(l)Mandatory:$() one, and only one, is required$(br)$(l)Valid positions:$() top face (not on frame)$(br)$(l)Graphical interface:$() yes
$(l)必需：$()必须且只能有一个$(br)$(l)有效位置：$()顶部面（不能在框架上）$(br)$(l)图形界面：$()是
